description: Coordinates an active production incident by establishing command, reducing blast radius, preserving evidence, communicating verified impact, restoring service, validating recovery, and creating owned follow-up actions. Use for outages, severe degradation, security or data-integrity events, failed releases, and urgent operational triage. Not for a normal local bug, routine alert tuning, or a postmortem after the incident is already closed.
